text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if I swap the data around, nothin' 
changes... huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... I should probably turn in early 
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, there's still a chord I haven't 
tried yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I'll roll it back and comb 
through it exhaustively..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't gonna get sleepy until this is 
finished anyway. I'm seein' it through!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Air Shakur was once again denied 
his precious sleep...
